What Is a Good Instagram Cold DM Reply Rate? (and How to Improve Yours)

How to measure your Instagram cold DM reply rate, what affects it, and practical ways to improve replies for local business and agency outreach.

By ColdNerd Team · October 26, 2026 · 2 min read

Reply rate is the single most useful number in Instagram outreach. It tells you whether your targeting and your message are working, long before you see sales. It is the core metric in our Instagram outreach guide.

How to calculate it

Reply rate = replies / messages delivered x 100. Track it per campaign and per template, and count only real replies (not auto-responses).

Why there is no universal benchmark

Reply rates vary widely by niche, offer, account trust and how well the list is targeted. Local businesses often reply more than large brands; warm audiences reply more than cold ones. The most useful benchmark is your own previous campaign. Aim to beat it.

What moves reply rate the most

  • Targeting: the right person with a real need beats any copywriting trick.

  • The opening line: specific, personal and about them, not you.

  • The ask: a simple question is easier to answer than a meeting request.

  • Follow-ups: a polite follow-up often produces a large share of replies.

  • Account trust: a complete, active profile gets opened more.

From replies to sign-ups

Track the whole funnel: messages sent, replies, positive replies, calls or trials, and customers. If replies are good but sign-ups are low, the issue is your offer or your follow-through, not your outreach.
